tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search fashion products on Realry.com. Put only the product itself in `query`, as a short noun phrase ("running shoes", "linen dress", "crossbody bag"), and put gender, price_min/price_max, colors, brand, sale_only/min_discount in their own parameters; use `category` only when the shopper asked for

tools.name: get_price_comparison
tools.description: Compare prices for a specific fashion product across all stores on Realry.com. Returns stores sorted cheapest first with direct purchase links, the sizes each store lists, and how fresh each store's stock data is.

tools.name: get_new_arrivals
tools.description: Browse the latest new arrivals on Realry.com, sorted by newest first. Optionally filter by keyword, price, gender, or color.

tools.name: get_sale_products
tools.description: Find sale and discounted fashion products on Realry.com. Optionally filter by keyword, minimum discount percentage, price range, gender, or color.

tools.name: get_trending_products
tools.description: Discover the most popular and trending fashion products on Realry.com, ranked by user likes. Optionally filter by keyword, price, gender, or color.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find fashion products similar to a given product on Realry.com. Useful for "show me more like this" or "find alternatives" requests. Use the Product ID from search_products results.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get the price history of a specific fashion product on Realry.com over the past 30 days. Helps users decide if now is a good time to buy.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Browse the hottest deals and discounted fashion products on Realry.com. Optionally filter by gender.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Search for fashion brands on Realry.com by name. Returns brand IDs that can be used with get_brand_products.

tools.name: get_brand_products
tools.description: Get featured products from a specific fashion brand on Realry.com. Use search_brands first to find the brand_id.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare multiple fashion products side-by-side on Realry.com — shows best price, discount rate, and number of stores for each. Use Product IDs from search_products results. Ideal for "which is cheaper?" or "help me decide between these" questions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_products" is 989 chars, far longer than this server's median (146). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
